title: Evaluating Prompting Strategies for Zero-Shot Multilingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have advanced natural language understanding, their ability to perform complex target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD) -- a key task within aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) -- in zero-shot multilingual settings remains underexplored. Existing ABSA research predominantly focuses on English or relies on fine-tuned task-specific models, leaving a gap in understanding how open-weight LLMs handle compound sentiment triplet extraction across diverse language families and domains. translated_title: 评估大型语言模型在零样本多语言方面级情感分析中的提示策略
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）已经推动了自然语言理解的发展，但它们在零样本多语言设置下执行复杂的目标-方面-情感检测（TASD）——这是方面级情感分析（ABSA）中的一项关键任务——的能力仍未得到充分探索。现有的ABSA研究主要集中于英语，或依赖于微调的任务特定模型，导致在理解开放权重LLM如何处理跨不同语系和领域的复合情感三元组提取方面存在空白。我们对零样本多语言TASD进行了系统性评估，涵盖12种语言和三个领域，使用了七个指令微调的开放权重模型——参数规模从8B到35B，涵盖稠密架构和专家混合架构——并在四种提示范式下进行测试：整体式、思维链、顺序式和顺序改进式。我们的结果表明，直接的整体式提示即可实现强大的零样本性能
tldr: 该论文系统评估了七个开放权重大语言模型在12种语言和三个领域的零样本多语言目标-方面-情感检测任务中的四种提示策略，发现简单的整体式提示即可取得强大的零样本性能。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates seven open-weight LLMs under four prompting paradigms for zero-shot multilingual target-aspect-sentiment detection across 12 languages and three domains, finding that simple monolithic prompting achieves strong zero-shot performance.
